versions.changelog:
zhuanzhuan 1.5.5

- 新增 skill 升级流程和版本检查要求：每次会话强制调用 version check，若有新版本需引导用户升级。
- 需根据 SKILL.md 头部 version 字段进行版本检查，升级后回到用户原始问题。
- 新增升级操作指引文档 guides/skill-upgrade.md。
- 移除原有 skill-card.md 文件。
- 其余核心业务、流程与参数约束规则不变。

Version 1.5.4

- Added user guides: detail-display.md, image-upload.md, and mcp-setup.md to clarify usage and integration steps.
- Included new skill icon (_icon.png).
- Removed obsolete documentation file (skill-card.md).
- No changes to the core logic or SKILL.md content.

zhuanzhuan v1.5.3

- Updated SKILL.md to clarify and expand external (user-facing) descriptions, including supported categories and use cases.
- Added more detailed, scenario-based keywords to improve intent match for a wider range of user phrasings.
- Clarified some process points in the "查行情" (market price) flow; link text changed from “行情解读” to “详情”.
- Removed redundant documentation file (skill-card.md); no changes to core business logic or workflows.

- Improved English and Chinese descriptions for greater clarity and detail.
- Added strict requirements and clarified business logic for preconditions and mandatory MCP server setup.
- Enhanced intent routing, with more precise rules for ambiguity resolution and user clarifications.
- Detailed the structure, display rules, and paging logic for searching and presenting used items.
- Refined workflows and response templates for product detail display, market trend checking, price evaluation and recycling, and "my page" queries.
- Emphasized service features and user guidance in all business flows.
